description: Implementation of functions for converting and casting OpenGL state query values, including template functions for handling various data types and state retrieval logic.

methods.name: ExpandFloatToInteger
methods.description: Converts a GLfloat to a 64-bit integer by applying a specific mathematical transformation.

methods.name: CastFromStateValueToInt
methods.description: Template function that converts a state value to an integer type, with special handling for float types.

methods.name: CastQueryValueToInt
methods.description: Converts a query value to an integer type, with rounding for float types.

methods.name: CastMaskValue
methods.description: Casts an unsigned integer mask to a signed integer.

methods.name: CastFromGLintStateValue
methods.description: Converts a GLint or GLint64 state value to a specified query type.

methods.name: CastFromStateValue
methods.description: Converts a native state value to a specified query type, handling various OpenGL data types.

methods.name: CastQueryValueTo
methods.description: Converts a query value to a native type, handling different OpenGL data types.

methods.name: CastStateValues
methods.description: Retrieves multiple state values from the context and converts them to a specified query type.

methods.name: CastIndexedStateValues
